events.summary: Standing water stopped traffic at Silk Board junction; service roads and the adjoining underpasses flooded after about 105 mm of rain in 24 hours.
Flood water entered houses in HSR Layout after torrential overnight rain; boats and tractor-trolleys were used in the worst stretches.
A day after the deluge, ST Bed Layout in Koramangala was still flooded; water had entered homes.
A Koramangala 6th Block resident said roads flooded within 30 minutes of rain starting at 11 pm and water entered houses by midnight, forcing families to move out.
Waterlogging on Hosur Main Road near Roopena Agrahara caused traffic snarls in the early hours of Sunday after overnight thundershowers.
An overflowing stormwater drain in Roopena Agrahara left at least four feet of water on the road and badly hit city-bound traffic, police said.
After torrential overnight rain, traffic police closed the Electronics City flyover because of waterlogging at Roopena Agrahara.
